turns.learner: Hi! Can we learn always, usually, sometimes and never today?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Yes. Always, usually, sometimes and never go before the main verb. After he, she and it, add -s to the verb. For example: My brother usually gets up at seven.

Now you try. Correct the verb: "She go to bed at ten."
